items.title: Phil Schaap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: Or really Irv Schenkler did the Charlie Parker Festival using my Charlie Parker chops. I’m the guy, he’s the producer. That’s a fair operation.

ctx.x: And the guys at KCR who I was trying to get them to like the music that Al Vollmer liked, they liked Ornette Coleman because they liked Charlie Parker. I said ahh, I see how that goes. So that’s part one. And then one of these people was a fellow named Irv Schenkler and he really produced the Charlie Parker festival on KCR because I really lit a fire for Bird. No he lit it himself, let’s give Irv Shenkler one hundred percent of the credit. But the Charlie Parker Festival is the turning point of KCR’s history. And…

Such a nice young fellow. Why waste your time?” And then I got on the radio and it got worse. “I never thought that you were stupid, Phil, I thought you were a beautiful cat. But that show you did today, Sonny Rollins. Play Bird.” And it’s a caricature now. I could do Lennie in voice thirty years ago. I mean and fool Lee Konitz. I did fool Lee.
